purpose: Independent full-field diagnostic layer built only from the seven persisted L1 expert horse-level scores.

architecture.ranking: For each expert, rank by raw_margin_logit desc, then horse_number asc when present, then horse_id asc. Aggregate horses by mean rank asc, Top6 support desc, Top3 support desc, Top1 votes desc, mean normalized probability desc, horse_number asc, horse_id asc.

rules: L1.7 is diagnostic only and does not alter L1.5.
No Gate or Outsider logic is allowed in L1.7.
No odds, popularity, payout, ROI or post-race result labels are allowed.
Input row order must not affect expert or consensus ranking.
2026 remains sealed for historical model-selection research.
